description: Schema definition and API documentation for the MaintenanceManager plugin, including methods for monitoring and controlling maintenance activities on set-top devices.

methods.name: getMaintenanceActivityStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current maintenance status details, including maintenance state, last completion time, criticality, and reboot pending status.

methods.name: getMaintenanceStartTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled start time for maintenance activities.

methods.name: setMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Configures maintenance mode and software upgrade opt-out mode, affecting how updates and maintenance activities are handled.

methods.name: startMaintenance
methods.description: Initiates maintenance activities and triggers status change events.

methods.name: stopMaintenance
methods.description: Stops ongoing maintenance activities and triggers status change events.

methods.name: getMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current maintenance mode and opt-out settings.
